verdict.rationale: Jira is a work-tracking and project-management product, so line-level code review of agent changes from a mobile app is outside its category; that belongs to code-hosting tools like Bitbucket. Nothing in the evidence shows Jira itself offering diff review, line comments, or an agent iteration loop. Its integrations only surface development status.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
